ns2:section.sectionText: This section is an online course. Students must have broadband access to the internet to participate. There will be one on-campus organizational meeting in late April or early May to cover logistics and address any questions. Registration restricted to Business Majors and Actuarial Science majors and specific Agri-Finance concentrations.. Any remaining seats will open to Business Minor students at approximately noon on Monday, April 28. PREREQUISITES WILL BE ENFORCED. Students missing one or more prerequisites will be removed from the course.
